definitions.explanation: A dwarf planet beyond Neptune, classified as a planet until 2006 when it was reclassified as a dwarf planet ({準惑星|じゅんわくせい}).

examples.japanese: {冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{準惑星|じゅんわくせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{太陽系|たいようけい}→太陽系：12216_taiyoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧だった。
examples.english: Pluto used to be one of the planets in the solar system.

examples.japanese: {冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二〇〇六年|にせんろくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{惑星|わくせい}→惑星：05052_wakusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}された→外す：02394_hazusu⟧。
examples.english: Pluto was removed from the definition of a planet in 2006.

notes:
Named after Pluto, Roman god of the underworld — written with {冥|めい} (underworld/dark) + ⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧ (king) + {星|せい} (planet). Now formally a {準惑星|じゅんわくせい} (dwarf planet) rather than a full planet.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衛星|えいせい}→衛星：01880_eisei⟧: Pluto's moons
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧: the discovery of Pluto
- {冥王星|めいおうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探査|たんさ}→探査：05325_tansa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explore Pluto

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {準惑星|じゅんわくせい}: dwarf planet — the official category that Pluto now belongs to
- ⟦{太陽系|たいようけい}→太陽系：12216_taiyoukei⟧: solar system
